results.title: Xperi Inc. Announces Participation in the BWS Financial Growth and Value Summer Investor Series
results.description: SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) (the “Company” or “Xperi”), an entertainment technology company that invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences, today announced that CEO Jon Kirchner and CFO Robert Andersen will host meetings at the BWS Financial Growth and Value Summer Investor Series on August 25, 2026, at the AMA Conference Center in New York City.
